name: Poshan Calculator
tagline: Smart Child Growth Assessment using WHO Standards

hero.title: Monitor Child Growth with Confidence
hero.subtitle: Poshan Calculator helps parents, pediatricians and healthcare professionals accurately evaluate child growth using WHO Growth Standards. Calculate BMI, Age, Height-for-Age, Weight-for-Age and other nutritional indicators in seconds.

overview: Poshan Calculator is a healthcare application designed to simplify child growth assessment. Instead of manually referring to WHO growth charts, the application provides instant, accurate growth analysis with an intuitive user experience.

modules.title: BMI Calculator
modules.description: Calculate Body Mass Index for children using WHO recommendations.

modules.title: Age Calculator
modules.description: Precisely calculate age in years, months and days.

faq.question: What can I calculate?
faq.answer: BMI, Age, Weight-for-Age, Height-for-Age, Weight-for-Height and other WHO growth indicators.

faq.question: Does it work offline?
faq.answer: Yes. Growth calculations work without an internet connection.

faq.question: Who can use it?
faq.answer: Parents, pediatricians, healthcare professionals and Anganwadi workers.
